'''Knobblypears''' were a type of [[Diet/Legends|edible]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that grew on [[Despayre]],<ref name="DS" /> a [[Prison/Legends|penal]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Rebellion game">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> The fruit was boiled by the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] working on the surface of Despayre and contributed to their minimal diet. All of the knobblypear [[Plant/Legends|plants]] on Despayre perished with the [[Destruction of Despayre|destruction]] of the planet by the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] that occurred in<ref name="DS" /> [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the final portions of [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], which includes the [[Destruction of Despayre]], in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Knobblypears were first mentioned in the [[2007]] novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], which was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="DS" />
